230:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

230:t_1:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「...I never thought we'd be fighting $$サイデリアル$$ here at the heart of the galaxy.」

230:t_1:5.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Could they... have followed us here?」

230:t_1:6.en:
$$マリー$$
「But if they did, $$サイデリアル$$ must have a way to travel between Earth and the galactic center.」

230:t_1:9.en:
$$レド$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ mainly operates here at the galactic center.」

230:t_1:10.en:
$$レド$$
「As a former member of the $$人類銀河同盟$$, I find it stranger that they stationed powerful $$リアクター$$s...」

230:t_1:11.en:
$$レド$$
「And their ruler, $$アウストラリス$$, on Earth, out on the galactic fringe.」

230:t_1:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think that was to obtain Earth's $$次元力$$.」

230:t_1:13.en:
$$レド$$
「I understand that now. But their main force is still based at the galactic center.」

230:t_1:14.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't know why they've deployed troops in this sector, but we should prepare ourselves for what's coming.」

230:t_1:15.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「We may face a force larger than any we've fought before...」

230:t_1:17.en:
$$シン$$
「Yeah... We've learned more about the end of the universe. We have to bring that information back to Earth, too.」

230:t_1:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I don't understand why, but if we can defeat $$バアル$$, the universe won't collapse...」

230:t_1:19.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That's right. We've still got $$バアル$$ to fight. We can't die out here.」

230:t_1:20.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「$n, Miss $$スズネ$$... The information you brought us has given us hope.」

230:t_1:23.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Well... This is embarrassing to admit...」

230:t_1:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I... don't really remember what happened after the will of the $$プロトカルチャー$$ appeared.」

230:t_1:25.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Get a grip, Miss $$スズネ$$. I know you love the occult, but you got way too carried away.」

230:t_1:26.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're right... I've been terribly forgetful lately, but I'll be more careful.」

230:t_1:28.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$ＹＦ－２９$$... I can use this now...」

230:t_1:29.en:
$$オズマ$$
「The $$マクロス７$$ fleet has been researching $$フォールドクォーツ$$, too...」

230:t_1:30.en:
$$オズマ$$
「They sent us the materials, and we've finished repairing it. Show me you can handle it, $$アルト$$.」

230:t_1:34.en:
$$アルト$$
「This $$ＹＦ－２９$$ was originally developed to carry your songs...」

230:t_1:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「But now... I'll fight in it to protect you both.」

230:t_1:36.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I believe in you, $$アルト$$...」

230:t_1:37.en:
$$シェリル$$
「You'd better come back alive. Otherwise...」

230:t_1:38.en:
$$アルト$$
「I know what you're going to say. ...Wait for me, $$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$.」

230:t_2:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But what could it possibly be for...?」

230:t_2:10.en:
???
「Do not forget hope, cursed wanderer. Your journey's end is near.」

230:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I don't understand... What could it be for...?」

230:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding! I was acting all serious. That's hardly like me!」

230:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... Our future is so uncertain that I'll have to put off our ace pilot celebration until next time.」

230:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I'm a dimensional merchant to my core! $$Ｄトレーダー$$ stays open for business no matter what!」

230:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, then...! Here's to~ your bright futures~! Let's get down to business again today!」

231:t_000:0.en:
$$マックス$$
「We drove off the first wave, but we've taken considerable damage ourselves...」

231:t_000:1.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Leaving our main forces, including $$エメラルドフォース$$, to defend the fleet has backfired.」

231:t_000:2.en:
$$マックス$$
「There's no point in hindsight...! Here they come!」

231:t_001:0.en:
$$マックス$$
「$$サイデリアル$$...! Are they trying to eliminate us for approaching the galactic center?!」

231:t_002:0.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「What will you do, Captain? These aren't the sort of people who accept surrender.」

231:t_002:1.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Yet I doubt they'll give us a chance to retreat in this situation, either.」

231:t_002:2.en:
$$マックス$$
「It isn't over yet...! They've arrived!」

231:t_003:1.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Dad, you're all right, aren't you?!」

231:t_003:2.en:
$$マックス$$
「Of course I am, $$ミレーヌ$$!」

231:t_003:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Captain $$マックス$$! We'll handle things here! Have the $$バトル７$$ fall back for now!」

231:t_003:4.en:
$$マックス$$
「My apologies...! I'll take you up on that offer!」

231:t_003:5.en:
$$マックス$$
「$$バトル７$$, fall back! All squadrons, follow us!」

231:t_004:0.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Captain $$マックス$$, stay safe.」

231:t_004:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I expected this, but there are so many enemies...!」

231:t_004:2.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, what's the situation?」

231:t_004:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have identified one battalion from $$サイデリアル$$'s Galactic Center Army.」

231:t_004:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「So even that force is only a small fraction of their strength.」

231:t_004:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are they after $$ネオ・ラクス$$... or us...?」

231:t_005:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「He hasn't changed a bit, even faced with a huge army like that...」

231:t_005:2.en:
$$カイエン$$
「What goes on inside his head?!」

231:t_005:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「He's completely beyond my understanding...」

231:t_005:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「That's fine, $$マリーダ$$. $$バサラ$$'s songs always cheer us up.」
